Narrator.evolving_description: The Narrator provides objective scene-setting and character insight, detailing Zach's emotional rollercoaster and coping mechanisms, while also marking chapter divisions.

Kalana.description: Kalana is a scared, vulnerable, and somewhat naive individual.
Kalana.evolving_description: Kalana is currently experiencing intense fear and vulnerability, openly admitting her terror in the face of complete darkness and an unknown, potentially endless, underground cavern.

Zach.evolving_description: Zach is currently overwhelmed by fear and stress, resorting to dark humor as a coping mechanism, and is determined to escape his dire situation despite physical pain.

Mr. Oren.description: Mr. Oren is a young, charismatic, and passionate biology teacher who makes learning engaging.
Mr. Oren.evolving_description: Mr. Oren is an eccentric and intelligent teacher, passionate about his subject, and has a unique, almost contradictory, personal appearance.

Unknown.description: A lewd, disruptive student who makes inappropriate jokes in class.
Unknown.evolving_description: The 'Unknown' character, a middle-aged woman, expresses sympathy and concern for Zach, offering comfort and advice. She represents the concerned, empathetic reactions of the surrounding community to the tragedy.

Pack.description: Antagonistic bully, larger than Zach, who insults Zach's dead mother.
Pack.evolving_description: Pack is a provocative and crude individual, seemingly enjoying shocking others with inappropriate comments, and is not afraid to instigate conflict.

Varsh.description: Varsh is a high-ranking, ruthless guild member, likely an enforcer, interrogating a spy for information.
Varsh.evolving_description: Varsh is a demanding and somewhat intimidating figure, quick to anger when his expectations aren't met, and is capable of physical threats.

Spy.description: A terrified, pathetic informant, not a true spy.

Seraphina.description: Seraphina is a dangerous, violent, and possibly sadistic individual who enjoys killing people with her rapier.
Seraphina.evolving_description: Seraphina is a bloodthirsty and eager individual, finding joy in violence and displaying a keen interest in her weapon and potential victims.

Unknown Male.description: A student, possibly a friend of Zach, encouraging a fight.
